modes-drawing: Drawing's pens sit in their own bar 12 px above the bottom bar, which keeps its tools; they used to replace the tools in the bottom bar.
modes-find: The find bar sits 12 px above the bottom bar, which keeps its tools; it used to sit beside Myra while the tools stepped aside.
modes-find-chat: With find up, Myra's chat rises over the find bar, which sits above the bottom bar; the find bar used to sit beside her while the tools stepped aside.
